what.a: Plato AI is an AI model aggregator platform. With a single account, you can chat with different AI models on one unified interface — no need to switch between platforms. Agent features to support your workflow are coming soon.

which.q: Which models does Plato AI support?
which.a: We support the latest models from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more. Our model list is updated in real time as new models are released. <link>Click here</link> to view the full list.

history.q: How long are chat histories saved?
history.a: Chat histories are saved permanently for both free and paid users. You can access your past conversations anytime.

frontier.q: Why do frontier models require credits?
frontier.a: Frontier models like GPT-5.4 Pro and Claude Opus deliver top-tier performance for more complex, demanding tasks. Because token usage varies significantly with conversation length and complexity, these models are billed with credits based on actual usage.

search.q: Why it's necessary to enable web search?
search.a:
AI is not a continuously updated information database. It relies on its existing knowledge and reasoning capabilities, which means it may not always have the latest information about news, policies, product updates, market trends, and other rapidly changing topics.

With Web Search enabled, AI can access up-to-date external information sources and provide more accurate responses based on the latest and most relevant information.

models.gpt-4-1-nano: The lightest and most cost-effective model launched by OpenAI, optimized for low-latency tasks, particularly suitable for applications requiring large-scale deployment, high-frequency calls, and cost sensitivity, providing the best value-for-money solution for simple AI tasks.

models.gpt-5-4-mini: GPT-5.4 mini is OpenAI's latest lightweight model with text and image input support, featuring tool calling and web search capabilities. It excels at coding, reasoning, and instruction following, ideal for high-volume workflows.
models.gpt-4o: GPT-4o is an advanced leap in AI for deep language understanding and generation, excels in multi-lingual support and efficiency.
models.gpt-5-4: Built on GPT-5.4, the Pro version is optimized for high-demand scenarios, supporting more complex tasks with exceptional professional performance.
models.gpt-5-3-codex: GPT-5.3 Codex is OpenAI’s most capable coding model, covering the full dev workflow from writing to debugging and deployment.
models.gpt-5-5: Built on GPT-5.4, the Pro version is optimized for high-demand scenarios, supporting more complex tasks with exceptional professional performance. (90 credits/1k tokens)
models.gpt-5-6-luna: Built on GPT-5.6 Luna is optimized for speed and efficiency, making it ideal for everyday conversations, writing, coding, and quick problem-solving.
models.gpt-5-6-terra: Built on GPT-5.6, Terra offers enhanced reasoning and accuracy for research, programming, data analysis, and other demanding professional tasks.
models.gpt-5-6-sol: Built on GPT-5.6 Sol delivers the highest level of reasoning and multimodal capabilities, designed for the most complex workflows, deep analysis, and expert-level problem-solving. (15 credits/1k tokens)
models.claude-haiku-4-5: Claude Haiku 4.5 is a next-generation fast-response model delivering lightning-speed inference while maintaining high performance, ideal for everyday conversations and real-time interactions.
models.claude-sonnet-4-6: Claude Sonnet 4.6 is Anthropic’s high-performance flagship model with breakthroughs in multimodal understanding, fast reasoning, and cost-effectiveness. It excels at real-time applications including content generation, customer service, and data analysis.
models.claude-sonnet-4-5: Claude Sonnet 4.5 is a next-generation hybrid reasoning model with major advances in long-term autonomy, tool use, and complex task handling, offering stronger coding and multi-step reasoning with massive context support.
models.claude-opus-4-7: Claude Opus 4.7 is Anthropic's latest flagship model with significant improvements in advanced software engineering, visual intelligence, and long-context reasoning. It excels at complex, long-running programming, document analysis, and enterprise knowledge work. (15 credits/1k tokens)
models.claude-opus-4-6: Claude Opus 4.6 is Anthropic's latest flagship model with breakthroughs in agentic planning, coding, and reasoning. Featuring adaptive thinking, it excels at complex programming, financial analysis, and enterprise knowledge work. (15 credits/1k tokens)
models.claude-opus-4-5: Claude Opus 4.5 is a next-generation flagship model with enhanced understanding and reasoning, built to handle complex tasks and support advanced professional use.(15 credits/1k tokens)
models.gemini-3-flash-preview: Gemini 3 Flash is a next-generation fast-response model designed for low latency and high-throughput use cases, delivering quick and reliable performance for real-time interactions.
models.gemini-3-1-pro-preview: Gemini 3.1 Pro is Google's latest flagship model with breakthroughs in multimodal reasoning, code generation, and complex problem-solving. It excels at advanced applications including software development, scientific research, and enterprise analytics.
